messages:
deploy-bot: Deployed redwood/gateway v1.10.0 to prod-canary (10% traffic) — commit abc123. Auto-rollback threshold: 2% 5xx OR 40% latency increase over baseline within 5m.

maria: watching the canary. tagging oncall.

raj: @maria @julie seeing a 5xx spike on canary: 3.5% over 1m, traces show repeated grpc: context canceled. p99 latency up ~220ms.

julie: runtime logs show a lot more KV cache misses after the new optimizer path landed. Could be causing backpressure to upstream.

raj: Has the auto-rollback kicked in? deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback triggered: threshold breached (5xx rate 3.5% > 2%). Initiating rollback to redwood/gateway v1.9.3. ETA ~90s. Reason: canary 5xx exceed threshold. Link: https://deploys.redwood.io/tx/abc123

maria: Good. Can we pin the route to v1.9.3 until validated? Also notify support.

julie: I'll confirm and run the pin. Steps I'll execute:
```
# pin route to v1.9.3
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routes/pin \
  -d '{"route":"/generate","version":"v1.9.3"}'
```

julie: Also disabling the new kernel optimizer flag in the canary cluster so it doesn't get re-enabled.

nick: I'll update support and put a note on status page: "Investigating increased error rates on model gateway; rollback in progress."

maria: Please create an incident and add rollback as mitigation. I'll draft a short status blurb for customers.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042. PagerDuty routed to: raj. Postmortem owner: julie.

raj: Metrics after rollback: 5xx back down to ~0.7% after ~3m, p99 latency back within baseline.

julie: Pin confirmed via API. Reverted canary feature flags. Next: open PR to revert optimizer change and run targeted staging canary.

maria: Communication plan: support update within the hour, customer-facing note for affected change window, and a release note entry.

nick: Support notified. Internal message: some customers may have seen 1-2 failed requests; recommend temporary retry guidance.

maria: Follow-ups: 1) root cause triage in eng-runtime, 2) add a canary noise suppression rule and extend auto-rollback window to 7m for transient spikes, 3) update rollback runbook with explicit pin command and run checklist. I'll create tickets.

julie: Opening the PR now and adding test cases for the cache behavior. Will update thread. :white_check_mark:

raj: Closing the monitoring loop. Will unmute alerts after 30m and continue to watch.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 1765123520. Canary closed. Metrics stabilized.

maria: Thanks everyone — good execution. Please include a timeline and mitigation notes in the postmortem.
